QUOTE: Compile time (no runtime cost): ... Define `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_CALLOC_MACRO` and `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_FREE_MACRO`. ... Runtime: Enable `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY` but leave out the two macros. Call `mbedtls_platform_set_calloc_free(my_calloc, my_free)`
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer separates the compile-time macro pair from the runtime function-pointer pair, and says the runtime route is used when the macros are left out. The table also says the macro route has "No function pointers and no runtime setter", which makes the two mutually exclusive.
